title: YouTube is reportedly offering channels “millions of dollars” not to cross-post videos on Netflix.
summary: Netflix has been paying YouTube creators, including Alan Chikin Chow, Nick DiGiovanni, and Mythical Entertainment, to post their videos on Netflix the same time they hit YouTube, Bloomberg recently reported .
